newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bandai raises shipment plan for Tamagotchi.
newsitem.headline: Bandai raises shipment plan for Tamagotchi.

text.p: Bandai Co Ltd said on Wednesday it has sharply raised planned domestic shipments of its electronic "virtual pet" toy, called "Tamagotchi", and is planning to launch it in the United States as early as July.

A Bandai spokeswoman said the firm expects cumulative shipments of the toy on the domestic market by the end of April to reach 4.5 million units since its launch last November. It expects the figure to rise to 6.5 million by the end of May.
At the beginning of this year, Bandai expected Tamagotchi shipments to rise to a cumulative total of three million units by the end of April, she said.
